structure.unit: Prisons and Other Methods of Correction
Treatment and Control of Prisoners Known to Be Pregnant

law.text: The Department shall provide, to the extent practicable, educational programming for prisoners known to be pregnant related to (i) prenatal care, (ii) pregnancy-specific hygiene, (iii) parenting skills, (iv) the impact of alcohol and drugs on the fetus, (v) postpartum recovery health, and (vi) the general health of children.
